svg.text: Reading late fade off ten DFN cycles: raw cycle-10 energy against a sqrt(cycle) extrapolation (fresh conditions, Sobol seed 12)
y: DFN@100 Wh/kg. blue: top 4 by raw cycle-10 Wh/kg; green: top 4 by the extrapolation; orange ring: pool best. The screen resumes the union to cycle 100.
Each union resumes at most 8 of 64 designs to 100 cycles; outcome in results.txt and LOG.md.
